blocks.x: Let's see. Was that a corn or what?
What kind of a horn did you like when you got one of your own? What kind did you use? I used to like to eat corn. A lot of people do. Yeah. I know some people think the Holton is a good trombone too.
I'd have a little bit spooly for them. What would you do? I wish corn or a marten.
That's a good make I know. Yeah.
Yeah, that was my trombone. He eat corn or he's a marten. My last one was a marten.
Jim Robinson has a marten now. Yeah. His new horn is a marten.
Yeah, nice. But I think C.E. Con got a better trombone than they never. To me, to my days, they used to I know. Like it was a more keener tone than the trombone.
